title: material_plannner
description: Material Planner is a survival-oriented building support mod that helps you calculate and manage the materials needed for construction.
body:
Material Planner is a survival-oriented building support mod.

It helps players calculate and prepare the materials they need for building projects, while keeping the fun of building everything by hand.

## QuantityWorkbench


![Quantity Workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Z2lLuze2/images/dca201eab6ae6655e73d407337f7845d7cd6acfd.png)
This mod is currently in beta. At the moment, only the QuantityWorkbench has been added.

The QuantityWorkbench is a dedicated workbench that lets you craft only the exact number of items you need.

You can enter the required quantity directly, paste a number using copy and paste, or adjust the amount easily with the mouse wheel.

It also supports JEI integration, allowing recipes to be inserted smoothly.

![Quantity Workbench recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Z2lLuze2/images/e1fda322891799e4f7cf0bd7708801d710405b39.png)

## Modpacks: Allowed.
 
You may include Material Planner in modpacks.
Please do not redistribute modified versions or reupload the mod separately.
